notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to reset bindings in the main menu by holding the Escape key for three seconds.
[*] Fixed an issue where the direction indicator showed red even when the movement was valid.
[*] Improved navigation to make it easier to find the way back in the level 96-99 section.
[*] Removed an unintended solution for the level "Wetstone."
[*] Made the world transition trigger more stable.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Cubi 4" achievement did not trigger.
[*] The tutorial reminder now appears only twice.
[*] The "change perspective" prompt is no longer shown on "normal" levels.
[*] Improved several sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer News Update 1 - New block that attaches to player
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718470/8f8fd1fe3b8d9e1a418f625a19626ea860eae3cd.gif[/img]

🌟 New Block, New Possibilities!
Ever felt the need for a little extra oomph in your blocky adventures? Well, buckle up because a brand-new block has joined the game! When you collide with this game-changer, it attaches to your block, opening up a world of exciting possibilities.

🚀 Master the Art of Block Manipulation!
Harness the power of attached blocks to navigate through levels like never before! Whether it's reaching new heights or taking unexpected shortcuts, these attachments will revolutionize the way you approach each puzzle. Strategize wisely, and the entire game board becomes your playground!

🚨 Handle with Care: Attachment Woes!
While the attached blocks offer unparalleled maneuverability, be cautious! Once attached, it can be a challenge to let go. Choose your attachments wisely, as the wrong move might leave you stuck in a bind. It's a true test of skill and foresight.

🔍 Discover the Detachment Solution!
Feeling trapped with an unwanted attachment? Fear not! Introducing the glitch block – your key to liberation. Locate one in the game, and maneuver your attached block into it. Voila! Consider the unwanted attachment history, and continue your blocky journey with newfound freedom.
